name: er7-rust
summary: A Cargo workspace of three independently-versioned Rust crates for HL7® v2 integration in the ER7 pipe-hat encoding — er7 (the encoding itself, zero dependencies), er7-redact (removes patient detail without changing shape), and serde-er7 (Serde support for the value tree).
context: This file curates the workspace's own files, with repo-relative links — `AGENTS.md`, `spec/index.md`, and the like — that resolve only inside a clone or checkout of this repository, not as URLs. For the same content addressed by absolute URL, so it resolves from anywhere, see the published site's own map at https://er7-rust.github.io/llms.json.

None of the three crates include a data-type dictionary, message-structure grammars, or validation — that is a deliberate layer above, built by the sibling `hl7-rust` project. Absent, empty, and explicit null are three different facts a field can carry, and collapsing them is the most common way integration code corrupts a clinical record — read `er7/index.md` before writing code against any of these crates.
